Chapter 808: Chapter 18 Taiyang Divine Master And Taiyin Sovereign (8000 Words, Chapter Two-In-One)_3

Chapter 808: Chapter 18 Taiyang Divine Master and Taiyin Sovereign (8000 words, Chapter Two-in-One)_3

“Weak?”

Heavenly Python Divine Master remained silent.

If one were to disregard the genuine and undeniable pressure he was facing, his behavior indeed seemed cowardly.

“I’m not weak, but if I weren’t, I would be dead.”

Heavenly Python Divine Master stated bluntly.

The senses of Demonic Divine Masters are always sharp, especially those who have grown to be Ninth Stage Evil Gods.

...

In the moment he faced Lin Yuan’s sidelong glance, Heavenly Python Divine Master truly felt the threat of complete annihilation.

Otherwise, why would he, Heavenly Python Divine Master, have acted in such a manner?

“Would die?”

Eight-Handed Lord’s expression became slightly solemn.

He had known Heavenly Python Divine Master for a long time and was aware that the latter would never exaggerate when it came to serious matters.

“That Taiyang Divine Master, so powerful?”

Eight-Handed Lord found it hard to believe. Any Demonic Divine Master who wanted to grow stronger needed countless years, during which time they would inevitably come into contact with other Demonic Divine Masters.

But this Taiyang Divine Master –

From the first time he showed up until now has only been three to five hundred years.

Three to five hundred years? Not to mention Demonic Divine Masters, even Sixth Stage and Seventh Stage Evil Gods, that’s but a brief moment in time.

“He must have grown to be a Ninth Stage Perfection Lord.”

Heavenly Python Divine Master said gravely.

“Ninth Stage Perfection?”

Eight-Handed Lord felt a suffocation.

In the vast Boundless Void, because of the existence of Void Secret Realms, there were still some Ninth Stage Evil Gods.

But a Lord who had grown to Ninth Stage Perfection was exceedingly rare.

Such a Lord had the power to kill ordinary Lords,

For them, becoming a Tenth Stage Evil God is the ultimate goal.

In the vast Endless Void, those who could be counted as Ninth Stage Perfection Lords were few, no more than a hundred.

“What should we do now?”

Eight-Handed Lord couldn’t help but ask.

He had not realized the situation was so grave. They – the Lords present – had actually faced off against a Ninth Stage Perfection Lord?

“What do we do?”

Heavenly Python Divine Master glanced at Eight-Handed Lord, “What can we do? If we encounter Taiyang Divine Master in the future, we must stay far away.”

“Yes, stay far away.”

Eight-Handed Lord was shocked and quickly agreed.

Among ordinary Demonic Divine Masters, even if there is a gap in strength, it’s not astronomical; at most, one would just withdraw in defeat.

But a Ninth Stage Perfection Lord could utterly kill an ordinary Lord; the implications were different.

Among Evil Gods, it’s survival of the fittest. Even reaching the Ninth Rank, consuming one’s own kind offers little benefit.

Yet some Demonic Divine Masters simply enjoy devouring their own kind.

…

The scene outside the Void Creature Nest was witnessed by no less than nineteen Demonic Divine Masters.

This consequently caused the strength of Taiyang Divine Master to spread swiftly among the Demonic Divine Masters.

Especially concerning a potential Ninth Stage Perfection Lord, the many Demonic Divine Masters were naturally highly concerned and sensitive to information about Taiyang Divine Master.

“Taiyang Divine Master, this strong?”

“There are nine Ninth Rank Void Creatures inside that Void Creature Nest? And one of them is a Monarch among Void Creatures?”

“It’s a trap, definitely a trap. That Void Creature Monarch is almost certainly close to Ninth Stage Perfection. Coupled with the home field advantage, as long as you dare to storm in, you’re sure to suffer heavy casualties, and there’s a very high chance your entire force will be annihilated.”

As word spread, many details about the Void Creature Nest, including the appearance and size of the Void Creature Monarch were disclosed, causing a scare among some Demonic Divine Masters. The conclusions drawn were even more startling to the many Demonic Divine Masters.

“Almost Ninth Stage Perfection Void Creature Monarch? Simply plucked out from the depths of the nest by Taiyang Divine Master, unable to resist?”

“This Taiyang Divine Master’s strength, it isn’t just suspected to be Ninth Stage Perfection, it’s definite Ninth Stage Perfection.”

“Apart from a Ninth Stage Perfection Evil God, who else could treat a Void Creature Monarch close to Ninth Stage Perfection as a mere plaything?”

One Demonic Divine Master after another grew pale, especially Heavenly Python Divine Master, Eight-Handed Lord, and the other nineteen Lords present, who were exceedingly frightened.

Strictly speaking, Taiyang Divine Master was also their savior?

…

Inside the Void Secret Realm, as well as many discussions among the Demonic Divine Masters in the vast Boundless Void, put Taiyang Divine Master at the center of a storm.

But this was within Lin Yuan’s expectations. With his increasing strength and the growing number of Void Creatures he killed, exposing his true strength was inevitable.

Presently, Lin Yuan had combat power at the peak of the Boundless Void; he was almost fearless, so these things did not concern him.

Besides, currently at the center of the storm was only the Taiyin Primordial Spirit.

Should there be any real problems, it would be Taiyang Divine Spirit’s concern. A mere Primordial Spirit, even if fallen, Lin Yuan could swiftly re-condense it.

…

“The forty-fourth world…”

In the dark void, Lin Yuan Taiyin Primordial Spirit silently merged into a world, planting the Demon Tree Seed deep into the earth.

In over three hundred years, Lin Yuan Taiyin Primordial Spirit had occupied world after world, spreading the Martial Tao Cultivation System to use as his major Martial Tao bastions in this dimension.

“Only, my actions of occupying worlds have already drawn the notice of many Evil Gods, and even some Lords.” Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

For Evil Gods, worlds are food, and after occupying a world, even if not immediately consumed, it’s impossible to do as Lin Yuan does: actively protecting the creatures within and even spreading a cultivation system.

Such unusual behavior, hard to hide from Evil Gods, some of which have special abilities that allow peering into the scenes within worlds.
